Four Held for Kidnapping Odisha Businessman, Including Police Officer and Journalist

Police have arrested four individuals, including a police officer and a journalist, in connection with the kidnapping of a businessman from Odisha. Authorities stated that the kidnapping was orchestrated with the intent to extort ₹50 lakh from the victim. The arrests were made following the planning of the crime.
